title: TTZipPackedStringArrayContract
description: JSON Schema contract representing the contiguous zero-fragment string array marshaling protocol.

count.description: Total number of strings packed in the array.

totalBytes.description: Total byte count of the contiguous string buffer including null terminators.

offsets.description: Starting byte offset of each string in the contiguous buffer.

contiguousUtf8Payload.description: Base64-encoded or raw packed null-delimited UTF-8 string payload.
